326	def _fill_topp_mask_rows(
327	    keep: torch.Tensor,
328	    ids: list[int],
329	    offsets: list[int],
330	    response_start: int,
331	    local_start: int,
332	    length: int,
333	    vocab_start: int,
334	    vocab_end: int,
335	) -> None:
336	    end = min(response_start + length, max(len(offsets) - 1, 0))
337	    for response_idx in range(response_start, end):
338	        local_ids = [
339	            token_id - vocab_start
340	            for token_id in ids[offsets[response_idx] : offsets[response_idx + 1]]
341	            if vocab_start <= token_id < vocab_end
342	        ]
343	        row = local_start + response_idx - response_start
344	        keep[row].fill_(False)
345	        if local_ids:
346	            keep[row, torch.tensor(local_ids, device=keep.device, dtype=torch.long)] = True
347

349	def _build_topp_keep_mask(
350	    T: int,
351	    vocab_local: int,
352	    device: torch.device,
353	    top_p_token_ids: list[list[int]],
354	    top_p_token_offsets: list[list[int]],
355	    total_lengths: list[int],
356	    response_lengths: list[int],
357	    allgather_cp: bool,
358	) -> torch.Tensor:
359	    """Build a ``[T, vocab_local]`` boolean keep-mask aligned to local logits.
360	
361	    For response token ``r`` of a sample, the rollout top-p nucleus is
362	    ``ids[offsets[r]:offsets[r + 1]]``. Rows without a recorded nucleus stay
363	    all-True, so only response rows with replay data are masked.
364	    """
365	    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
366	    tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
367	    vocab_start = tp_rank * vocab_local
368	    vocab_end = vocab_start + vocab_local
369	
370	    # Normalize ragged payloads (may arrive as CPU int32 tensors) to python lists.
371	    top_p_token_ids = [t.tolist() if torch.is_tensor(t) else list(t) for t in top_p_token_ids]
372	    top_p_token_offsets = [t.tolist() if torch.is_tensor(t) else list(t) for t in top_p_token_offsets]
373	
374	    keep = torch.ones((T, vocab_local), dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
375	
376	    if cp_size > 1 and not allgather_cp:
377	        local_base = 0
378	        for ids, offsets, total_length, response_length in zip(
379	            top_p_token_ids, top_p_token_offsets, total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False
380	        ):
381	            prompt_length = total_length - response_length
382	            chunk_size_cp, chunks_offset, logits_offset, tokens_offset = get_logits_and_tokens_offset_with_cp(
383	                total_length, response_length
384	            )
385	            for half, base in ((0, local_base), (1, local_base + chunk_size_cp)):
386	                local_start = base + logits_offset[half][0] - chunks_offset[half][0]
387	                length = logits_offset[half][1] - logits_offset[half][0]
388	                response_start = tokens_offset[half][0] - prompt_length
389	                _fill_topp_mask_rows(keep, ids, offsets, response_start, local_start, length, vocab_start, vocab_end)
390	            local_base += 2 * chunk_size_cp
391	        return keep
392	
393	    if allgather_cp:
394	        cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
395	        chunk_start = cp_rank * T
396	        chunk_end = chunk_start + T
397	        seq_start = 0
398	        for ids, offsets, total_length, response_length in zip(
399	            top_p_token_ids, top_p_token_offsets, total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False
400	        ):
401	            prompt_length = total_length - response_length
402	            logit_global_start = seq_start + prompt_length - 1
403	            logit_global_end = seq_start + total_length - 1
404	            s = max(logit_global_start, chunk_start)
405	            e = min(logit_global_end, chunk_end)
406	            if e > s:
407	                _fill_topp_mask_rows(
408	                    keep,
409	                    ids,
410	                    offsets,
411	                    s - logit_global_start,
412	                    s - chunk_start,
413	                    e - s,
414	                    vocab_start,
415	                    vocab_end,
416	                )
417	            seq_start += total_length
418	        return keep
419	
420	    offset = 0
421	    for ids, offsets, total_length, response_length in zip(
422	        top_p_token_ids, top_p_token_offsets, total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False
423	    ):
424	        end = offset + total_length
425	        start = end - response_length
426	        _fill_topp_mask_rows(keep, ids, offsets, 0, start - 1, response_length, vocab_start, vocab_end)
427	        offset += total_length
428	
429	    return keep
430

432	def _extract_per_sample(
433	    log_prob_full: torch.Tensor,
434	    entropy_full: torch.Tensor | None,
435	    total_lengths: list[int],
436	    response_lengths: list[int],
437	    allgather_cp: bool,
438	) -> tuple[list[torch.Tensor], list[torch.Tensor | None]]:
439	    """Slice per-sample response log-probs/entropy from full-length 1-D tensors."""
440	    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
441	    log_probs_list: list[torch.Tensor] = []
442	    entropy_list: list[torch.Tensor] = []
443	
444	    if cp_size > 1 and not allgather_cp:
445	        # zigzag CP
446	        pos = 0
447	        for total_length, response_length in zip(total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False):
448	            chunk_size_cp, chunks_offset, logits_offset, _tokens_offset = get_logits_and_tokens_offset_with_cp(
449	                total_length, response_length
450	            )
451	            lo0 = logits_offset[0][0] - chunks_offset[0][0]
452	            hi0 = logits_offset[0][1] - chunks_offset[0][0]
453	            lo1 = logits_offset[1][0] - chunks_offset[1][0]
454	            hi1 = logits_offset[1][1] - chunks_offset[1][0]
455	
456	            lp = torch.cat(
457	                [
458	                    log_prob_full[pos + lo0 : pos + hi0],
459	                    log_prob_full[pos + chunk_size_cp + lo1 : pos + chunk_size_cp + hi1],
460	                ],
461	                dim=0,
462	            )
463	            log_probs_list.append(lp)
464	            if entropy_full is not None:
465	                ent = torch.cat(
466	                    [
467	                        entropy_full[pos + lo0 : pos + hi0],
468	                        entropy_full[pos + chunk_size_cp + lo1 : pos + chunk_size_cp + hi1],
469	                    ],
470	                    dim=0,
471	                )
472	                entropy_list.append(ent)
473	            pos += 2 * chunk_size_cp
474	
475	    elif allgather_cp:
476	        cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
477	        local_len = log_prob_full.size(0)
478	        chunk_start = cp_rank * local_len
479	        chunk_end = chunk_start + local_len
480	
481	        seq_start = 0
482	        for total_length, response_length in zip(total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False):
483	            prompt_length = total_length - response_length
484	            logit_global_start = seq_start + prompt_length - 1
485	            logit_global_end = seq_start + total_length - 1
486	
487	            s = max(logit_global_start, chunk_start)
488	            e = min(logit_global_end, chunk_end)
489	            if e <= s:
490	                log_probs_list.append(log_prob_full[:0])
491	                if entropy_full is not None:
492	                    entropy_list.append(entropy_full[:0])
493	            else:
494	                log_probs_list.append(log_prob_full[s - chunk_start : e - chunk_start])
495	                if entropy_full is not None:
496	                    entropy_list.append(entropy_full[s - chunk_start : e - chunk_start])
497	            seq_start += total_length
498	
499	    else:
500	        # cp1
501	        offset = 0
502	        for total_length, response_length in zip(total_lengths, response_lengths, strict=False):
503	            end = offset + total_length
504	            start = end - response_length
505	            log_probs_list.append(log_prob_full[start - 1 : end - 1])
506	            if entropy_full is not None:
507	                entropy_list.append(entropy_full[start - 1 : end - 1])
508	            offset += total_length
509	
510	    return log_probs_list, entropy_list
511

513	def get_log_probs_and_entropy(
514	    logits: torch.Tensor,
515	    *,
516	    args: Namespace,
517	    unconcat_tokens: list[torch.Tensor],
518	    total_lengths: list[int],
519	    response_lengths: list[int],
520	    with_entropy: bool = False,
521	    non_loss_data: bool = True,
522	    top_p_token_ids: list[list[int]] | None = None,
523	    top_p_token_offsets: list[list[int]] | None = None,
524	) -> dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]:
525	    """Compute per-token log-probabilities (and optionally entropy) on responses.
526	
527	    Computes on the **full** logits ``[T, V]`` tensor at once (instead of
528	    per-sample slicing) so backward traverses ``[T, V]`` only once, then
529	    extracts per-sample response portions.
530	
531	    If rollout top-p replay is provided, the keep-mask is applied only to
532	    log-probabilities; entropy is always computed from the unmasked logits.
533	    """
534	    assert non_loss_data
535	    assert logits.dtype == torch.float32, f"{logits.dtype}"
536	    assert len(logits.shape) == 3, f"{logits.shape}"
537	    assert logits.size(0) == 1, f"{logits.shape}"
538	    logits = logits.squeeze(0)
539	
540	    # Apply rollout temperature scaling to logits to match rollout-time log-probs.
541	    rollout_temperature = getattr(args, "rollout_temperature", 1.0)
542	    if rollout_temperature != 1.0:
543	        logits = logits / rollout_temperature
544	    logits = logits.contiguous()
545	    T = logits.size(0)
546	    device = logits.device
547	    tp_group = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_group()
548	    chunk_size = args.log_probs_chunk_size
549	    # Keep entropy metrics, but skip saving entropy-backward activations when
550	    # the entropy term cannot affect the loss.
551	    with_entropy_grad = with_entropy and getattr(args, "entropy_coef", 0.0) != 0
552	
553	    # --- build full shifted-token target tensor ---
554	    full_tokens = _build_shifted_tokens(T, device, unconcat_tokens, total_lengths, response_lengths, args.allgather_cp)
555	
556	    # --- build top-p nucleus keep-mask (logprob only; entropy stays unmasked) ---
557	    top_p_keep_mask = None
558	    if top_p_token_ids is not None and top_p_token_offsets is not None:
559	        top_p_keep_mask = _build_topp_keep_mask(
560	            T,
561	            logits.size(-1),
562	            device,
563	            top_p_token_ids,
564	            top_p_token_offsets,
565	            total_lengths,
566	            response_lengths,
567	            args.allgather_cp,
568	        )
569	
570	    # --- compute on full [T,V] logits at once via calculate_log_probs_and_entropy ---
571	    log_prob_full, entropy_full = calculate_log_probs_and_entropy(
572	        logits,
573	        full_tokens,
574	        tp_group,
575	        with_entropy=with_entropy,
576	        with_entropy_grad=with_entropy_grad,
577	        chunk_size=chunk_size,
578	        log_prob_keep_mask=top_p_keep_mask,
579	    )
580	    log_prob_full = log_prob_full.squeeze(-1)  # [T, 1] -> [T]
581	
582	    # --- extract per-sample response portions ---
583	    log_probs_list, entropy_list = _extract_per_sample(
584	        log_prob_full,
585	        entropy_full,
586	        total_lengths,
587	        response_lengths,
588	        args.allgather_cp,
589	    )
590	
591	    res = {"log_probs": log_probs_list}
592	    if with_entropy:
593	        res["entropy"] = entropy_list
594	
595	    # we need to turn the all gather kv into zigzag ring attn kv
596	    if args.allgather_cp:
597	        _allgather_cp_redistribute(
598	            res,
599	            logits_local_len=T,
600	            total_lengths=total_lengths,
601	            response_lengths=response_lengths,
602	        )
603	
604	    return torch.empty((0,), device=device), res
605

607	def get_values(
608	    logits: torch.Tensor,
609	    *,
610	    args: Namespace,
611	    unconcat_tokens: list[torch.Tensor],
612	    total_lengths: list[int],
613	    response_lengths: list[int],
614	    with_entropy: bool = False,
615	    non_loss_data: bool = True,
616	) -> dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]:
617	    """Extract per-token value predictions over response tokens.
618	
619	    For each sample, extracts response-aligned chunks from the value head
620	    output and squeezes the final dimension from `[R, 1]` to `[R]`.
621	
622	    Args:
623	        logits: Value head output with shape `[1, T, 1]`.
624	        args: Configuration passed to `get_responses`; temperature scaling is
625	            disabled for value outputs.
626	        unconcat_tokens: List of token tensors per sample.
627	        total_lengths: Total sequence lengths per sample.
628	        response_lengths: Response segment lengths per sample.
629	        with_entropy: Unused; kept for signature compatibility.
630	        non_loss_data: Unused; kept for signature compatibility.

632	    Returns:
633	        Dict with key "values" mapping to a list of `[R]` value tensors
634	        per sample.
635	    """
636	    value_list = []
637	    for logits_chunk, _ in get_responses(
638	        logits,
639	        args=args,

641	        total_lengths=total_lengths,
642	        response_lengths=response_lengths,
643	        apply_temperature=False,
644	    ):
645	        assert logits_chunk.size(-1) == 1, f"{logits_chunk.shape}"
646	        value_list.append(logits_chunk.squeeze(-1))
647	
648	    res = {
649	        "values": value_list,
650	    }
651	
652	    if args.allgather_cp:
653	        _allgather_cp_redistribute(
654	            res,
655	            logits_local_len=logits.size(1),
656	            total_lengths=total_lengths,
657	            response_lengths=response_lengths,
658	        )
659	
660	    return torch.empty((0,), device=logits.device), res

663	def apply_opd_kl_to_advantages(
664	    args: Namespace,
665	    rollout_data: RolloutBatch,
666	    advantages: list[torch.Tensor],
667	    student_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor] | None,
668	) -> None:
669	    """Apply on-policy distillation KL penalty to advantages.
670	
671	    Computes reverse KL (student_logp - teacher_logp) and adds weighted penalty
672	    to advantages in-place. This is orthogonal to the base advantage estimator.
673	
674	    Args:
675	        args: Configuration containing `use_opd` and `opd_kl_coef`.
676	        rollout_data: Dict containing "teacher_log_probs".
677	        advantages: List of advantage tensors to modify in-place.
678	        student_log_probs: List of student log-probability tensors.
679	
680	    References:
681	        https://github.com/thinking-machines-lab/tinker-cookbook/blob/main/tinker_cookbook/distillation/train_on_policy.py
682	    """
683	
684	    if student_log_probs is None:
685	        return
686	
687	    teacher_log_probs = rollout_data.get("teacher_log_probs")
688	    if teacher_log_probs is None:
689	        raise ValueError(f"OPD with opd_type='{args.opd_type}' requires teacher_log_probs, but it is missing.")
690	
691	    device = student_log_probs[0].device
692	    teacher_log_probs = [t.to(device=device) for t in teacher_log_probs]
693	
694	    reverse_kls = []
695	    for i, adv in enumerate(advantages):
696	        reverse_kl = student_log_probs[i] - teacher_log_probs[i]
697	        advantages[i] = adv - args.opd_kl_coef * reverse_kl
698	        reverse_kls.append(reverse_kl)
699	
700	    # Store reverse KL for logging
701	    rollout_data["opd_reverse_kl"] = reverse_kls
702

704	def compute_advantages_and_returns(args: Namespace, rollout_data: RolloutBatch) -> None:
705	    """Compute advantages and returns in-place based on `args.advantage_estimator`.
706	
707	    This function extracts rewards, log-probs, values, and masks from
708	    `rollout_data`, computes KL divergences, then applies the chosen advantage
709	    estimator. Supported methods: "grpo", "gspo", "cispo", "ppo",
710	    "reinforce_plus_plus", and "reinforce_plus_plus_baseline". When
711	    `args.normalize_advantages` is True, advantages are whitened across the
712	    data-parallel-with-context-parallel group using masked statistics.
713	
714	    Early returns if both `log_probs` and `values` are None (intermediate
715	    pipeline stages).
716	
717	    If ``args.custom_advantage_function_path`` is set, it is called after KL computation
718	    and must populate ``rollout_data["advantages"]`` and
719	    ``rollout_data["returns"]``.
720	
721	    Args:
722	        args: Configuration specifying estimator type, KL coefficient,
723	            normalization settings, and other hyperparameters.

725	            "rewards", "values", "response_lengths", "loss_masks",
726	            "total_lengths"). Modified in-place to add "advantages" and
727	            "returns" keys, each mapping to lists of tensors per sample.
728	    """
729	    rollout_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor] | None = rollout_data.get("rollout_log_probs")

732	    )
733	    ref_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor] = rollout_data.get("ref_log_probs")

735	    values: None | list[torch.Tensor] = rollout_data.get("values")

744	        # when kl_coef is 0, we won't compute ref_log_prob
745	        xs = log_probs or rollout_log_probs or values

748	        kl = [
749	            compute_approx_kl(
750	                log_probs[i],
751	                ref_log_probs[i],
752	                kl_loss_type=args.kl_loss_type,
753	            )
754	            for i in range(len(log_probs))

759	        custom_adv_fn = load_function(args.custom_advantage_function_path)

762	
763	    elif args.advantage_estimator in ["grpo", "gspo", "cispo"]:

766	        # TODO: is the copy necessary?
767	        advantages = [r for r in returns]
768	
769	    elif args.advantage_estimator == "ppo":
770	        old_rewards = rewards
771	        rewards = []

775	            k *= kl_coef
776	            if cp_rank == 0:

778	            rewards.append(k)

781	        )
782	
783	    elif args.advantage_estimator == "reinforce_plus_plus":

786	            rewards=rewards,
787	            kl=kl,

806	    else:

809	    # Apply on-policy distillation KL penalty to advantages (orthogonal to advantage estimator)

812	            args=args,
813	            rollout_data=rollout_data,
814	            advantages=advantages,

816	        )

818	    # TODO: OpenRLHF always does advantages normalization but veRL doesn't seem to do it.
819	    if args.normalize_advantages:

822	        if cp_size == 1:

824	        else:
825	            mask_chunks = []
826	            for i in range(len(advantages)):

828	                response_len = response_lengths[i]

830	                _, _, _, token_offsets = get_logits_and_tokens_offset_with_cp(total_len, response_len)

832	                # Convert global offsets to response-space offsets
833	                s0, e0 = token_offsets[0]
834	                s1, e1 = token_offsets[1]

836	                res_s1, res_e1 = max(0, s1 - prompt_len), max(0, e1 - prompt_len)
837	
838	                local_mask_parts = []
839	                full_mask = loss_masks[i]
840	                if res_e0 > res_s0:
841	                    local_mask_parts.append(full_mask[res_s0:res_e0])
842	                if res_e1 > res_s1:
843	                    local_mask_parts.append(full_mask[res_s1:res_e1])
844	
845	                # Concatenate the parts to form the final mask chunk for this rank and this sequence
846	                local_mask_chunk = (
847	                    torch.cat(local_mask_parts)
848	                    if local_mask_parts
849	                    else torch.tensor([], device=all_advs.device, dtype=full_mask.dtype)
850	                )
851	                mask_chunks.append(local_mask_chunk)
852	
853	            all_masks = torch.cat(mask_chunks)
854	
855	        assert (
856	            all_advs.size() == all_masks.size()
857	        ), f"Shape mismatch before whitening: advantages {all_advs.size()}, masks {all_masks.size()}"

859	        # statistics must be reduced over the DP group *with* context parallel.
860	        # The CP-excluding group makes every CP rank whiten its own zigzag slice
861	        # with its own mean/var, i.e. the two halves of one sequence get
862	        # different affine transforms.
863	        #
864	        # This has to stay unconditional: a CP rank can legitimately own zero
865	        # response tokens (prompt-heavy sequences put both of its chunks inside
866	        # the prompt), and skipping the collective on just that rank would
867	        # desync the all_reduce. `distributed_masked_whiten` handles an empty
868	        # local tensor — it contributes 0 to the reduced sums.
869	        dp_cp_group = mpu.get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True)
870	
871	        whitened_advs_flat = distributed_masked_whiten(
872	            all_advs,
873	            all_masks,
874	            process_group=dp_cp_group,
875	            shift_mean=True,
876	        )
877	        chunk_lengths = [chunk.size(0) for chunk in advantages]
878	        advantages = list(torch.split(whitened_advs_flat, chunk_lengths))
879	
880	    rollout_data["advantages"] = advantages
881	    rollout_data["returns"] = returns

884	def vanilla_tis_function(
885	    args,
886	    *,
887	    pg_loss: torch.Tensor,
888	    train_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor],
889	    rollout_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor],
890	    loss_masks: list[torch.Tensor],
891	    **kwargs: Any,
892	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor], dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
893	    rollout_log_probs = torch.cat(rollout_log_probs, dim=0)
894	    old_log_probs = torch.cat(train_log_probs, dim=0)
895	    tis = torch.exp(old_log_probs - rollout_log_probs)
896	    tis_abs = (torch.exp(old_log_probs - rollout_log_probs) - 1).abs()
897	    tis_weights = torch.clamp(tis, min=args.tis_clip_low, max=args.tis_clip)
898	    tis_clipfrac = (tis_weights != tis).float()
899	    metrics = {
900	        "tis": tis.clone().detach(),
901	        "tis_clipfrac": tis_clipfrac.clone().detach(),
902	        "tis_abs": tis_abs.clone().detach(),
903	    }
904	    pg_loss = pg_loss * tis_weights
905	    return pg_loss, loss_masks, metrics

908	def icepop_function(
909	    args,
910	    *,
911	    pg_loss: torch.Tensor,
912	    train_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor],
913	    rollout_log_probs: list[torch.Tensor],
914	    loss_masks: list[torch.Tensor],
915	    **kwargs: Any,
916	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor], dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
917	    rollout_log_probs = torch.cat(rollout_log_probs, dim=0)
918	    old_log_probs = torch.cat(train_log_probs, dim=0)
919	    ice_ratio = torch.exp(old_log_probs - rollout_log_probs)
920	    ice_abs = (torch.exp(old_log_probs - rollout_log_probs) - 1).abs()
921	    ice_weight = torch.where(
922	        (ice_ratio >= args.tis_clip_low) & (ice_ratio <= args.tis_clip), ice_ratio, torch.zeros_like(ice_ratio)
923	    )
924	    ice_clipfrac = (ice_weight != ice_ratio).float()
925	    metrics = {
926	        "tis": ice_ratio.clone().detach(),
927	        "tis_clipfrac": ice_clipfrac.clone().detach(),
928	        "tis_abs": ice_abs.clone().detach(),
929	    }
930	    pg_loss = pg_loss * ice_weight
931	    return pg_loss, loss_masks, metrics

934	def policy_loss_function(

940	    """Compute policy loss (PPO/GSPO) and metrics.
941	
942	    Computes current log-probabilities and entropy from model logits, then
943	    calculates PPO-style clipped policy gradient loss. For GSPO, gathers
944	    full sequences via context-parallel all-gather before computing per-sample

961	        "tis", "ois", "tis_clipfrac" are included when the respective features

1005	            for old_log_prob, total_length, response_length in zip(

1178	    batch: RolloutBatch,
1179	    logits: torch.Tensor,
1180	    sum_of_sample_mean: Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor],
1181	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
1182	    """Compute clipped value loss and metrics.
1183	
1184	    Extracts current value predictions from `logits`, compares them against
1185	    stored old values with clipping, and computes the maximum of clipped and
1186	    unclipped squared errors (PPO-style value clipping).
1187	
1188	    Args:
1189	        args: Configuration containing `value_clip` threshold.
1190	        batch: Mini-batch with "values" (old predictions), "returns",
1191	            "unconcat_tokens", "total_lengths", and "response_lengths".
1192	        logits: Value head output with shape `[1, T, 1]`.
1193	        sum_of_sample_mean: Reduction function that averages per-sample values.
1194	
1195	    Returns:
1196	        Tuple of `(loss, metrics)` where `loss` is a scalar tensor and
1197	        `metrics` contains detached scalars "value_loss" and "value_clipfrac".
1198	    """
1199	    old_values = torch.cat(batch["values"], dim=0)
1200	
1201	    _, values = get_values(
1202	        logits,
1203	        args=args,
1204	        unconcat_tokens=batch["unconcat_tokens"],
1205	        total_lengths=batch["total_lengths"],
1206	        response_lengths=batch["response_lengths"],
1207	    )
1208	    values = torch.cat([value.flatten() for value in values["values"]], dim=0)
1209	
1210	    returns = torch.cat(batch["returns"], dim=0)
1211	
1212	    values_clipfrac = torch.abs(values - old_values) > args.value_clip
1213	    values_clipped = old_values + (values - old_values).clamp(-args.value_clip, args.value_clip)
1214	    surr1 = (values_clipped - returns) ** 2
1215	    surr2 = (values - returns) ** 2
1216	    loss = torch.max(surr1, surr2)
1217	
1218	    loss = sum_of_sample_mean(loss)
1219	    values_clipfrac = sum_of_sample_mean(values_clipfrac.float())
1220	
1221	    # make sure the gradient could backprop correctly.
1222	    if values.numel() == 0:
1223	        loss += 0 * values.sum()
1224	
1225	    reported_loss = {
1226	        "value_loss": loss.clone().detach(),
1227	        "value_clipfrac": values_clipfrac.clone().detach(),
1228	    }
1229	
1230	    return loss, reported_loss
1231	
1232	
1233	def sft_loss_function(
1234	    args: Namespace,
1235	    batch: RolloutBatch,
1236	    logits: torch.Tensor,
1237	    sum_of_sample_mean: Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor],
1238	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
1239	    """Compute supervised fine-tuning loss over response tokens.
1240	
1241	    Computes log-probabilities of the ground-truth tokens in the response
1242	    segments and returns the negative log-likelihood as the loss.
1243	
1244	    Args:
1245	        args: Configuration (passed through to helpers).
1246	        batch: Mini-batch with "unconcat_tokens", "response_lengths", and
1247	            "total_lengths".
1248	        logits: Policy logits with shape `[1, T, V]`.
1249	        sum_of_sample_mean: Reduction function that averages per-sample values.
1250	
1251	    Returns:
1252	        Tuple of `(loss, metrics)` where `metrics` contains a single detached
1253	        scalar "loss".
1254	    """
1255	    response_lengths = batch["response_lengths"]
1256	    total_lengths = batch["total_lengths"]
1257	
1258	    _, log_probs_and_entropy = get_log_probs_and_entropy(
1259	        logits,
1260	        args=args,
1261	        unconcat_tokens=batch["unconcat_tokens"],
1262	        total_lengths=total_lengths,
1263	        response_lengths=response_lengths,
1264	        with_entropy=False,
1265	    )
1266	
1267	    log_probs = log_probs_and_entropy["log_probs"]
1268	    log_probs = torch.cat(log_probs, dim=0)
1269	    loss = -sum_of_sample_mean(log_probs)
1270	
1271	    # make sure the gradient could backprop correctly.
1272	    if log_probs.numel() == 0:
1273	        loss += 0 * logits.sum()
1274	
1275	    return (
1276	        loss,
1277	        {
1278	            "loss": loss.clone().detach(),
1279	        },
1280	    )
1281	
1282	
1283	def loss_function(
1284	    args: Namespace,
1285	    batch: RolloutBatch,
1286	    num_microbatches: int,
1287	    step_global_batch_size: int,
1288	    logits: torch.Tensor,
1289	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int | torch.Tensor, dict[str, list[str] | torch.Tensor]]:
1290	    """Dispatch to the configured loss and rescale for Megatron integration.
1291	
1292	    Selects one of "policy_loss", "value_loss", "sft_loss", or a custom loss
1293	    function based on `args.loss_type`, computes the loss and metrics, then
1294	    rescales the loss by micro-batch and parallelism factors to integrate with
1295	    Megatron's gradient accumulation.
1296	
1297	    Args:
1298	        args: Configuration specifying `loss_type`, `calculate_per_token_loss`,
1299	            and optionally `custom_loss_function_path`.
1300	        batch: Mini-batch with "loss_masks", "response_lengths", and other
1301	            keys required by the selected loss function.
1302	        num_microbatches: Number of gradient accumulation steps.
1303	        step_global_batch_size: Sample count for the current training step
1304	            (total across DP). Replaces the legacy ``args.global_batch_size``
1305	            fallback so the train side stops depending on "every DP rank holds
1306	            the same N samples".
1307	        logits: Model outputs (policy or value head).
1308	
1309	    Returns:
1310	        Tuple of `(scaled_loss, normalizer, logging_dict)` where:
1311	        - `scaled_loss` is the loss tensor (scalar) rescaled for Megatron.
1312	        - `normalizer` is `num_tokens` (scalar tensor) if
1313	          `args.calculate_per_token_loss` is True, else `1` (int).
1314	        - `logging_dict` has keys "keys" (list of str metric names) and
1315	          "values" (1D tensor: [count, metric1, metric2, ...]).
1316	    """
1317	    num_tokens = sum([torch.clamp_min(loss_mask.sum(), 1) for loss_mask in batch["loss_masks"]])
1318	
1319	    sum_of_sample_mean = get_sum_of_sample_mean(
1320	        batch["total_lengths"],
1321	        batch["response_lengths"],
1322	        batch["loss_masks"],
1323	        batch["rollout_mask_sums"],
1324	        args.calculate_per_token_loss,
1325	    )
1326	
1327	    match args.loss_type:
1328	        case "policy_loss":
1329	            func = policy_loss_function
1330	        case "value_loss":
1331	            func = value_loss_function
1332	        case "sft_loss":
1333	            func = sft_loss_function
1334	        case "custom_loss":
1335	            func = load_function(args.custom_loss_function_path)
1336	        case _:
1337	            raise ValueError(f"Unknown loss type: {args.loss_type}")
1338	
1339	    if args.recompute_loss_function:
1340	        loss, log = checkpoint(func, args, batch, logits, sum_of_sample_mean, use_reentrant=False)
1341	    else:
1342	        loss, log = func(args, batch, logits, sum_of_sample_mean)
1343	
1344	    # With allgather-CP, some CP ranks may have no loss-contributing tokens (e.g., all
1345	    # padding). Without this, gradient doesn't flow through their attention path, so
1346	    # the CP gather's backward (reduce-scatter) is not called, deadlocking other CP
1347	    # ranks that call it. Adding this zero loss forces autograd to traverse the full
1348	    # graph on every rank without changing gradient values.
1349	    if args.allgather_cp and mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size() > 1:
1350	        loss = loss + 0 * logits.sum()
1351	
1352	    # Here we need to divide by cp_size because to cancel the multiply in Megatron.
1353	    if not args.calculate_per_token_loss:
1354	        loss = (
1355	            loss
1356	            * num_microbatches
1357	            / step_global_batch_size
1358	            * mpu.get_data_parallel_world_size(with_context_parallel=True)
1359	        )
1360	    else:
1361	        loss = loss * mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()

1363	    return (
1364	        loss,
1365	        (num_tokens if args.calculate_per_token_loss else torch.tensor(1, device=logits.device)),
1366	        {
1367	            "keys": list(log.keys()),
1368	            # values[0] is the consumer's reporting denominator after
1369	            # all-reduce. For per-token-loss it must equal step total tokens
1370	            # (only known by summing per-mb num_tokens across mbs / DP). For
1371	            # per-rollout-mean it is a constant — ``step_global_batch_size`` —
1372	            # so we leave a 0 placeholder here and let ``train_one_step``
1373	            # substitute the constant directly, instead of routing it through
1374	            # per-mb fractions.
1375	            "values": torch.tensor(
1376	                [
1377	                    num_tokens if args.calculate_per_token_loss else 0,
1378	                ]
1379	                + list(log.values()),
1380	                device=logits.device,
1381	            ),
1382	        },

import re
import signal


def last_boxed_only_string(string: str) -> str | None:
    """Extract the last LaTeX boxed expression from a string.

    Args:
        string: Input string containing LaTeX code

    Returns:
        The last boxed expression or None if not found
    """
    idx = string.rfind("\\boxed{")
    if idx < 0:
        return None

    i = idx
    right_brace_idx = None
    num_left_braces_open = 0

    while i < len(string):
        if string[i] == "{":
            num_left_braces_open += 1
        if string[i] == "}":
            num_left_braces_open -= 1
            if num_left_braces_open == 0:
                right_brace_idx = i
                break
        i += 1

    return string[idx : right_brace_idx + 1] if right_brace_idx is not None else None


def remove_boxed(s: str) -> str:
    """Remove the LaTeX boxed command from a string.

    Args:
        s: String with format "\\boxed{content}"

    Returns:
        The content inside the boxed command
    """
    left = "\\boxed{"
    assert s[: len(left)] == left, f"box error: {s}"
    assert s[-1] == "}", f"box error: {s}"
    return s[len(left) : -1]

def normalize_final_answer(final_answer: str) -> str:
    """Normalize a final answer to a quantitative reasoning question.

    Args:
        final_answer: The answer string to normalize

    Returns:
        Normalized answer string
    """
    final_answer = str(final_answer)
    final_answer = final_answer.split("=")[-1]

    # Apply substitutions and removals
    for before, after in SUBSTITUTIONS:
        final_answer = final_answer.replace(before, after)
    for expr in REMOVED_EXPRESSIONS:
        final_answer = final_answer.replace(expr, "")

    # Extract and normalize LaTeX math
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(.*?)(\$)(.*?)(\$)(.*)", "$\\3$", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(\\text\{)(.*?)(\})", "\\2", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(\\textbf\{)(.*?)(\})", "\\2", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(\\overline\{)(.*?)(\})", "\\2", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(\\boxed\{)(.*)(\})", "\\2", final_answer)

    # Normalize shorthand TeX:
    #  \fracab -> \frac{a}{b}
    #  \frac{abc}{bef} -> \frac{abc}{bef}
    #  \fracabc -> \frac{a}{b}c
    #  \sqrta -> \sqrt{a}
    #  \sqrtab -> sqrt{a}b
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(frac)([^{])(.)", "frac{\\2}{\\3}", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(sqrt)([^{])", "sqrt{\\2}", final_answer)
    final_answer = final_answer.replace("$", "")

    # Normalize numbers
    if final_answer.replace(",", "").isdigit():
        final_answer = final_answer.replace(",", "")

    return final_answer.strip()


def is_correct_minerva(
    solution_str: str, gt: str, gt_need_extract: bool = False, answer_pattern: str = r"(?i)Answer\s*:\s*([^\n]+)"
) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Check if the solution is correct according to Minerva criteria.

    Args:
        solution_str: The solution string to check
        gt: The ground truth answer
        gt_need_extract: Whether the ground truth needs extraction
        answer_pattern: Regex pattern to extract the answer

    Returns:
        Tuple of (is_correct, normalized_prediction)
    """
    # Extract answer from solution
    match = re.findall(answer_pattern, solution_str)
    extracted_answer = match[-1] if match else "[INVALID]"
    pred = normalize_final_answer(extracted_answer)

    # Process ground truth
    if gt_need_extract:
        gt = normalize_final_answer(remove_boxed(last_boxed_only_string(gt)))
    else:
        gt = normalize_final_answer(gt)

    gt = str(int(float(gt)))  # in dapo, all answers are integers

    return (pred == gt), pred


def is_correct_strict_box(pred: str, gt: str, pause_tokens_index: list[int] | None = None) -> tuple[int, str | None]:
    """Check if the prediction is correct using strict boxed answer criteria.

    Args:
        pred: The prediction string
        gt: The ground truth answer
        pause_tokens_index: Indices of pause tokens

    Returns:
        Tuple of (score, extracted_prediction)
    """
    # Extract the relevant part of the prediction
    if pause_tokens_index is not None:
        assert len(pause_tokens_index) == 4
        pred = pred[pause_tokens_index[-1] - 100 :]

import re
import signal


def last_boxed_only_string(string: str) -> str | None:
    """Extract the last LaTeX boxed expression from a string.

    Args:
        string: Input string containing LaTeX code

    Returns:
        The last boxed expression or None if not found
    """
    idx = string.rfind("\\boxed{")
    if idx < 0:
        return None

    i = idx
    right_brace_idx = None
    num_left_braces_open = 0

    while i < len(string):
        if string[i] == "{":
            num_left_braces_open += 1
        if string[i] == "}":
            num_left_braces_open -= 1
            if num_left_braces_open == 0:
                right_brace_idx = i
                break
        i += 1

    return string[idx : right_brace_idx + 1] if right_brace_idx is not None else None


def remove_boxed(s: str) -> str:
    """Remove the LaTeX boxed command from a string.

    Args:
        s: String with format "\\boxed{content}"

    Returns:
        The content inside the boxed command
    """
    left = "\\boxed{"
    assert s[: len(left)] == left, f"box error: {s}"
    assert s[-1] == "}", f"box error: {s}"
    return s[len(left) : -1]


class timeout:

    def __init__(self, seconds=1, error_message="Timeout"):
        self.seconds = seconds
        self.error_message = error_message

    def handle_timeout(self, signum, frame):
        raise TimeoutError(self.error_message)

    def __enter__(self):
        signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, self.handle_timeout)
        signal.alarm(self.seconds)

    def __exit__(self, type, value, traceback):
        signal.alarm(0)


# Constants for normalization
SUBSTITUTIONS = [
    ("an ", ""),
    ("a ", ""),
    (".$", "$"),
    ("\\$", ""),
    (r"\ ", ""),
    (" ", ""),
    ("mbox", "text"),
    (",\\text{and}", ","),
    ("\\text{and}", ","),
    ("\\text{m}", "\\text{}"),
]

REMOVED_EXPRESSIONS = [
    "square",
    "ways",
    "integers",
    "dollars",
    "mph",
    "inches",
    "hours",
    "km",
    "units",
    "\\ldots",
    "sue",
    "points",
    "feet",
    "minutes",
    "digits",
    "cents",
    "degrees",
    "cm",
    "gm",
    "pounds",
    "meters",
    "meals",
    "edges",
    "students",
    "childrentickets",
    "multiples",
    "\\text{s}",
    "\\text{.}",
    "\\text{\ns}",
    "\\text{}^2",
    "\\text{}^3",
    "\\text{\n}",
    "\\text{}",
    r"\mathrm{th}",
    r"^\circ",
    r"^{\circ}",
    r"\;",
    r",\!",
    "{,}",
    '"',
    "\\dots",
    "<|im_end|>",
    "<|endoftext|>",
]


def normalize_final_answer(final_answer: str) -> str:
    """Normalize a final answer to a quantitative reasoning question.

    Args:
        final_answer: The answer string to normalize

    Returns:
        Normalized answer string
    """
    final_answer = str(final_answer)
    final_answer = final_answer.split("=")[-1]

    # Apply substitutions and removals
    for before, after in SUBSTITUTIONS:
        final_answer = final_answer.replace(before, after)
    for expr in REMOVED_EXPRESSIONS:
        final_answer = final_answer.replace(expr, "")

    # Extract and normalize LaTeX math
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(.*?)(\$)(.*?)(\$)(.*)", "$\\3$", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(\\text\{)(.*?)(\})", "\\2", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(\\textbf\{)(.*?)(\})", "\\2", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(\\overline\{)(.*?)(\})", "\\2", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(\\boxed\{)(.*)(\})", "\\2", final_answer)

    # Normalize shorthand TeX:
    #  \fracab -> \frac{a}{b}
    #  \frac{abc}{bef} -> \frac{abc}{bef}
    #  \fracabc -> \frac{a}{b}c
    #  \sqrta -> \sqrt{a}
    #  \sqrtab -> sqrt{a}b
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(frac)([^{])(.)", "frac{\\2}{\\3}", final_answer)
    final_answer = re.sub(r"(sqrt)([^{])", "sqrt{\\2}", final_answer)
    final_answer = final_answer.replace("$", "")

    # Normalize numbers
    if final_answer.replace(",", "").isdigit():
        final_answer = final_answer.replace(",", "")

    return final_answer.strip()


def is_correct_minerva(
    solution_str: str, gt: str, gt_need_extract: bool = False, answer_pattern: str = r"(?i)Answer\s*:\s*([^\n]+)"
) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Check if the solution is correct according to Minerva criteria.

    Args:
        solution_str: The solution string to check
        gt: The ground truth answer
        gt_need_extract: Whether the ground truth needs extraction
        answer_pattern: Regex pattern to extract the answer

    Returns:
        Tuple of (is_correct, normalized_prediction)
    """
    # Extract answer from solution
    match = re.findall(answer_pattern, solution_str)
    extracted_answer = match[-1] if match else "[INVALID]"
    pred = normalize_final_answer(extracted_answer)

    # Process ground truth
    if gt_need_extract:
        gt = normalize_final_answer(remove_boxed(last_boxed_only_string(gt)))
    else:
        gt = normalize_final_answer(gt)

    gt = str(int(float(gt)))  # in dapo, all answers are integers

    return (pred == gt), pred


def is_correct_strict_box(pred: str, gt: str, pause_tokens_index: list[int] | None = None) -> tuple[int, str | None]:
    """Check if the prediction is correct using strict boxed answer criteria.

    Args:
        pred: The prediction string
        gt: The ground truth answer
        pause_tokens_index: Indices of pause tokens

    Returns:
        Tuple of (score, extracted_prediction)
    """
    # Extract the relevant part of the prediction
    if pause_tokens_index is not None:
        assert len(pause_tokens_index) == 4
        pred = pred[pause_tokens_index[-1] - 100 :]
    else:
        pred = pred[-100:]

    # Extract and check the boxed answer
    boxed_pred = last_boxed_only_string(pred)
    extracted_pred = remove_boxed(boxed_pred) if boxed_pred is not None else None

    return 1 if (extracted_pred == gt) else -1, extracted_pred

11	    release_train = args.release_train

13	    # allocate the GPUs
14	    pgs = create_placement_groups(args)
15	    init_tracking(args)

20

22	
23	    if args.offload_rollout and not release_train:
24	        ray.get(rollout_manager.onload_weights.remote())
25	
26	    # Always push actor weights to rollout once weights are loaded.
27	    actor_model.update_weights()
28	
29	    if args.check_weight_update_equal:
30	        ray.get(rollout_manager.check_weights.remote(action="compare"))
31	
32	    if args.offload_rollout:
33	        ray.get(rollout_manager.onload_kv.remote())
34	
35	    # special case for eval-only
36	    if args.num_rollout == 0 and args.eval_interval is not None:
37	        ray.get(rollout_manager.eval.remote(rollout_id=0))
38	
39	    def offload_train(actor_trains_this_step):
40	        # Each model auto-offloads after train() when offload_train is set,
41	        # so we only need clear_memory for the non-offload case.
42	        if not args.offload_train:
43	            if not args.use_critic or actor_trains_this_step:
44	                actor_model.clear_memory()
45	            else:
46	                critic_model.clear_memory()
47	
48	    # train loop.
49	    for rollout_id in range(args.start_rollout_id, args.num_rollout):
50	        if args.eval_interval is not None and rollout_id == 0 and not args.skip_eval_before_train:
51	            ray.get(rollout_manager.eval.remote(rollout_id))
52

import dataclasses
import itertools
import logging
import multiprocessing
import os
import random
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
import ray
import torch
from ray.util.scheduling_strategies import PlacementGroupSchedulingStrategy
from sglang.srt.constants import GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_CUDA_GRAPH, GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_KV_CACHE, GPU_MEMORY_TYPE_WEIGHTS

from slime.backends.sglang_utils.external import start_external_rollout_servers
from slime.backends.sglang_utils.sglang_config import ModelConfig, ServerGroupConfig, SglangConfig
from slime.backends.sglang_utils.sglang_engine import SGLangEngine
from slime.rollout.base_types import call_rollout_fn
from slime.rollout.sample_hooks import set_current_rollout_id
from slime.utils import logging_utils
from slime.utils.data import get_source
from slime.utils.dp_schedule import build_dp_schedule
from slime.utils.health_monitor import RolloutHealthMonitor
from slime.utils.http_utils import _wrap_ipv6, find_available_port, get_host_info, init_http_client
from slime.utils.logging_utils import configure_logger, init_tracking
from slime.utils.metric_utils import compute_pass_rate, compute_rollout_step, compute_statistics, dict_add_prefix
from slime.utils.misc import Box, group_by, load_function
from slime.utils.types import Sample

from ..utils.metric_utils import has_repetition
from .rollout_validation import validate_server_group_gpu_indices
from .utils import (
    NOSET_VISIBLE_DEVICES_ENV_VARS_LIST,
    Lock,
    add_default_ray_env_vars,
    memory_saver_loader_env,
)

logging.getLogger("httpx").setLevel(logging.WARNING)
logging.getLogger("httpcore").setLevel(logging.WARNING)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_ROLLOUT_DATA_TENSOR_DTYPES = {
    "tokens": torch.long,
    "loss_masks": torch.int,
    "rollout_log_probs": torch.float32,
    "rollout_top_p_token_ids": torch.int32,
    "rollout_top_p_token_offsets": torch.int32,
    "teacher_log_probs": torch.float32,
    "rollout_routed_experts": None,
}

_SGLANG_REQUEST_PERF_FIELDS = (
    ("request/e2e_latency", "e2e_latency"),
    ("request/queue_time", "queue_time"),
    ("decode/throughput", "decode_throughput"),
)
_SGLANG_PREFILL_PERF_FIELDS = (
    ("prefill/bootstrap_queue_duration", "pd_prefill_bootstrap_queue_duration"),
    ("prefill/bootstrap_duration", "pd_prefill_bootstrap_duration"),
    ("prefill/alloc_wait_duration", "pd_prefill_alloc_wait_duration"),
    ("prefill/forward_duration", "pd_prefill_forward_duration"),
    ("prefill/transfer_queue_duration", "pd_prefill_transfer_queue_duration"),
    ("prefill/transfer_speed_gb_s", "pd_transfer_speed_gb_s"),
    ("prefill/transfer_total_mb", "pd_transfer_total_mb"),
    ("prefill/retry_count", "pd_prefill_retry_count"),
)
_SGLANG_DECODE_PERF_FIELDS = (
    ("decode/prealloc_duration", "pd_decode_prealloc_duration"),
    ("decode/bootstrap_duration", "pd_decode_bootstrap_duration"),
    ("decode/alloc_wait_duration", "pd_decode_alloc_wait_duration"),
    ("decode/transfer_duration", "pd_decode_transfer_duration"),
    ("decode/forward_duration", "pd_decode_forward_duration"),
)


def _cpu_tensor(value, dtype: torch.dtype | None = None) -> torch.Tensor:
    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray) and not value.flags.writeable:
        value = value.copy()
    tensor = torch.as_tensor(value, dtype=dtype) if dtype is not None else torch.as_tensor(value)
    return tensor.detach().cpu().contiguous()


def _tensorize_rollout_data_for_training(rollout_data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    for key, dtype in _ROLLOUT_DATA_TENSOR_DTYPES.items():
        if key in rollout_data:
            rollout_data[key] = [_cpu_tensor(value, dtype=dtype) for value in rollout_data[key]]

    if "multimodal_train_inputs" in rollout_data:
        rollout_data["multimodal_train_inputs"] = [
            (
                {
                    key: _cpu_tensor(value) if isinstance(value, (np.ndarray, torch.Tensor)) else value
                    for key, value in mm_dict.items()
                }
                if mm_dict is not None
                else None
            )
            for mm_dict in rollout_data["multimodal_train_inputs"]
        ]

    if "rollout_mask_sums" in rollout_data:
        rollout_data["rollout_mask_sums"] = _cpu_tensor(
            rollout_data["rollout_mask_sums"],
            dtype=torch.float32,
        )


def _validate_rollout_routed_experts_for_replay(
    routed_experts: list[torch.Tensor],
    args,
) -> None:
    """Reject incomplete PP routing captures before R3 consumes them."""
    if not routed_experts:
        raise ValueError("R3 is enabled but no rollout routed-experts tensors were returned.")

    num_layers = int(args.num_layers)
    topk = int(args.moe_router_topk)
    moe_layer_freq = getattr(args, "moe_layer_freq", None)
    if isinstance(moe_layer_freq, (list, tuple)):
        moe_layers = [layer_id for layer_id, freq in enumerate(moe_layer_freq[:num_layers]) if int(freq) != 0]
    else:
        moe_layers = list(range(num_layers))

    for sample_idx, experts in enumerate(routed_experts):
        experts = torch.as_tensor(experts)
        if experts.ndim != 3 or tuple(experts.shape[1:]) != (num_layers, topk):
            raise ValueError(
                "Invalid rollout routed-experts shape for R3: "
                f"sample={sample_idx}, got={tuple(experts.shape)}, "
                f"expected=(*, {num_layers}, {topk})."
            )
        if experts.shape[0] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"R3 sample {sample_idx} has no routed-experts rows.")
        if topk > 1:
            missing_layers = [layer_id for layer_id in moe_layers if not torch.count_nonzero(experts[:, layer_id, :])]
            if missing_layers:
                raise ValueError(
                    "R3 routed-experts capture is all zero for MoE layers "
                    f"{missing_layers} in sample {sample_idx}. This usually means "
                    "SGLang pipeline stages did not aggregate their disjoint routing "
                    "captures; refusing to replay expert 0 everywhere."
                )


@dataclasses.dataclass
class ServerGroup:
    """A group of homogeneous SGLang engines with the same configuration.

    All engines in a group share the same tp_size / nodes_per_engine / pg.
    A RolloutServer may contain multiple ServerGroups (e.g. prefill vs decode
    in PD disaggregation).
    """

    args: Any
    pg: Any  # (placement_group, reordered_bundle_indices, reordered_gpu_ids)
    all_engines: list
    num_gpus_per_engine: int
    num_new_engines: int
    worker_type: str = "regular"  # "regular", "prefill", "decode", or "placeholder"
    rank_offset: int = 0  # cumulative engine count before this group
    gpu_offset: int = 0  # cumulative GPU count before this group
    sglang_overrides: dict = dataclasses.field(default_factory=dict)
    needs_offload: bool = False  # True when this group's GPUs overlap with megatron
    model_path: str | None = None  # checkpoint path for update_weights_from_disk
    router_ip: str | None = None
    router_port: int | None = None

    @property
    def nodes_per_engine(self):
        return max(1, self.num_gpus_per_engine // self.args.num_gpus_per_node)

    @property
    def engines(self):
        """Node-0 engines only (for multi-node serving)."""
        return self.all_engines[:: self.nodes_per_engine]

    def parallel_config(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the SGLang parallel args that affect rank-local expert routing."""
        overrides = {key.replace("-", "_"): value for key, value in self.sglang_overrides.items()}
        pp_size = int(overrides.get("pp_size", getattr(self.args, "sglang_pp_size", 1)))
        tp_size = int(overrides.get("tp_size", self.num_gpus_per_engine // pp_size))
        return {
            "tp_size": tp_size,
            "pp_size": pp_size,
            "ep_size": int(overrides.get("ep_size", getattr(self.args, "sglang_ep_size", 1))),
            "moe_dp_size": int(overrides.get("moe_dp_size", getattr(self.args, "sglang_moe_dp_size", 1))),
        }

    def start_engines(self, port_cursors: dict[int, int] | None = None) -> tuple[list, dict[int, int]]:
        """Create Ray actors, allocate ports, and fire ``engine.init()`` without waiting.

        Returns ``(init_handles, port_cursors)`` where *init_handles* is a list
        of Ray ObjectRefs and *port_cursors* maps node index → next free port.
        The caller should ``ray.get()`` on the handles to block until the
        engines are healthy, and pass *port_cursors* to the next server group
        so that different groups on the same node don't race for ports.

        Placeholder groups (worker_type="placeholder") skip engine creation entirely.
        """
        if port_cursors is None:
            port_cursors = {}
        if self.args.debug_train_only or self.worker_type == "placeholder":
            self.num_new_engines = 0
            return [], port_cursors

        num_gpus_per_engine_on_node = min(self.num_gpus_per_engine, self.args.num_gpus_per_node)

        pg, reordered_bundle_indices, reordered_gpu_ids = self.pg
        validate_server_group_gpu_indices(
            worker_type=self.worker_type,
            gpu_offset=self.gpu_offset,
            num_gpus_per_engine=self.num_gpus_per_engine,
            num_gpus_per_engine_on_node=num_gpus_per_engine_on_node,
            num_engines=len(self.all_engines),
            num_available_gpus=len(reordered_gpu_ids),
            rollout_num_gpus=self.args.rollout_num_gpus,
            rollout_num_gpus_per_engine=self.args.rollout_num_gpus_per_engine,
        )

        RolloutRayActor = ray.remote(SGLangEngine)

        rollout_engines = []
        for i in range(len(self.all_engines)):
            if self.all_engines[i] is not None:
                continue

            global_rank = self.rank_offset + i
            num_gpus = 0.2
            num_cpus = num_gpus

            # Get the base GPU ID from placement group using gpu_offset.
            gpu_index = self.gpu_offset + i * num_gpus_per_engine_on_node
            base_gpu_id = int(reordered_gpu_ids[gpu_index])

            scheduling_strategy = PlacementGroupSchedulingStrategy(
                placement_group=pg,
                placement_group_capture_child_tasks=True,
                placement_group_bundle_index=reordered_bundle_indices[gpu_index],
            )

            env_vars = {name: "1" for name in NOSET_VISIBLE_DEVICES_ENV_VARS_LIST} | {
                key: os.environ.get(key, default_val)
                for key, default_val in {
                    "SGLANG_JIT_DEEPGEMM_PRECOMPILE": "false",
                    "SGLANG_JIT_DEEPGEMM_FAST_WARMUP": "true",
                    "SGL_DISABLE_TP_MEMORY_INBALANCE_CHECK": "true",
                    "SGLANG_DISABLE_TP_MEMORY_INBALANCE_CHECK": "true",
                    "SGLANG_MEMORY_SAVER_CUDA_GRAPH": "true",
                    "SGLANG_BATCH_INVARIANT_OPS_ENABLE_MM_FALLBACK_VARIANT": "true",
                    "SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION": "false",
                    "SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_IDLE": "false",

4	def get_response_lengths(loss_masks: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
5	    # return the lengths starting from the first occurrence of 1 to the end of each loss mask
6	    return [len(mask[mask.index(1) :]) if 1 in mask else 0 for mask in loss_masks]

9	class MultiTurnLossMaskGenerator:
10	    def __init__(self, tokenizer: AutoTokenizer, tokenizer_type: str = "qwen"):
11	        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
12	        self.tokenizer_type = tokenizer_type
13	        self.system_message_length = 0
14	        self.gen_token_length = 0
15	        if self.tokenizer_type in ("qwen", "qwen3"):
16	            self.system_message_length, self.gen_token_length = self.get_system_message_length()
17	
18	    def get_response_lengths(self, loss_masks: list[list[int]]) -> list[int]:
19	        return get_response_lengths(loss_masks)

21	    def find_all_sublist_indices(self, main_list, sublist):
22	        sublist_len = len(sublist)
23	        indices = []
24	        for i in range(len(main_list) - sublist_len + 1):
25	            if main_list[i : i + sublist_len] == sublist:
26	                indices.append(i)
27	        return indices

29	    def get_system_message_length(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
30	        test_string = "FOR TESTING ONLY"
31	        test_messages = [
32	            {"role": "user", "content": test_string},
33	            {"role": "user", "content": test_string},
34	        ]
35	        raw_token_ids = self.tokenizer(test_string, add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"]
36	        chat_template_token = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
37	            test_messages, add_special_tokens=False, tokenize=False
38	        )
39	        chat_template_token_ids = self.tokenizer(chat_template_token, add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"]
40	        idx_1, idx_2 = self.find_all_sublist_indices(chat_template_token_ids, raw_token_ids)
41	        end_interval = len(chat_template_token_ids) - len(raw_token_ids) - idx_2
42	        gen_token_length = len(
43	            self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
44	                test_messages,
45	                add_special_tokens=False,
46	                tokenize=True,
47	                add_generation_prompt=True,
48	                return_dict=False,
49	            )
50	        ) - len(chat_template_token_ids)
51	
52	        system_message_length = idx_1 - ((idx_2 - idx_1) - end_interval - len(raw_token_ids))
53	        return system_message_length, gen_token_length

55	    def gen_multi_turn_loss_mask_qwen(
56	        self, messages: list[dict], tools: list[dict] = None
57	    ) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
58	        all_loss_masks = []
59	        all_token_ids = []
60	
61	        for i, message in enumerate(messages):
62	            if i == 0:
63	                message_ids = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
64	                    [message], tokenize=True, tools=tools, return_dict=False
65	                )
66	            else:
67	                message_ids = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template([message], tokenize=True, return_dict=False)
68	
69	            if message["role"] != "system" and i > 0:
70	                message_ids = message_ids[self.system_message_length :]
71	
72	            if message["role"] == "assistant":
73	                loss_mask = [0] * self.gen_token_length + [1] * (len(message_ids) - self.gen_token_length)
74	            else:
75	                loss_mask = [0] * len(message_ids)
76	
77	            if message.get("step_loss_mask", 1) != 1:
78	                loss_mask = [0] * len(message_ids)
79	
80	            all_loss_masks.extend(loss_mask)
81	            all_token_ids.extend(message_ids)

85	    def gen_multi_turn_loss_mask_qwen3(
86	        self, messages: list[dict], tools: list[dict] = None
87	    ) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
88	        all_loss_masks = []
89	        all_token_ids = []
90	
91	        prefix_message = {"role": "user", "content": "FOR CALCULATING LOSS MASK ONLY"}
92	        prefix_token_ids = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template([prefix_message], tokenize=True, return_dict=False)
93	
94	        i = 0
95	        while i < len(messages):
96	            message = messages[i]
97	            if message["role"] == "tool":
98	                # Qwen templates wrap consecutive tool responses in a single user turn.
99	                group_end = i + 1
100	                while group_end < len(messages) and messages[group_end]["role"] == "tool":
101	                    group_end += 1
102	                message_group = messages[i:group_end]
103	            else:
104	                group_end = i + 1
105	                message_group = [message]
106	
107	            if i == 0:
108	                tailed_message_ids = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
109	                    message_group + [prefix_message],
110	                    tokenize=True,
111	                    tools=tools,
112	                    return_dict=False,
113	                )
114	                message_ids = tailed_message_ids[: -len(prefix_token_ids)]
115	            else:
116	                prefixed_message_ids = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
117	                    [prefix_message] + message_group,
118	                    tokenize=True,
119	                    return_dict=False,
120	                )
121	                message_ids = prefixed_message_ids[len(prefix_token_ids) :]
122	
123	            if message["role"] != "system" and i > 0:
124	                message_ids = message_ids[self.system_message_length :]
125	
126	            if message["role"] == "assistant":
127	                loss_mask = [0] * self.gen_token_length + [1] * (len(message_ids) - self.gen_token_length)
128	            else:
129	                loss_mask = [0] * len(message_ids)
130	
131	            if message.get("step_loss_mask", 1) != 1:
132	                loss_mask = [0] * len(message_ids)
133	
134	            all_loss_masks.extend(loss_mask)
135	            all_token_ids.extend(message_ids)
136	            i = group_end
137	
138	        return all_token_ids, all_loss_masks

140	    def gen_multi_turn_loss_mask_qwen3_5(
141	        self, messages: list[dict], tools: list[dict] = None
142	    ) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
143	        rendered_text = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, tools=tools, return_dict=False)
144	        tokenized = self.tokenizer(rendered_text, add_special_tokens=False, return_offsets_mapping=True)
145	        token_ids = tokenized["input_ids"]
146	        offset_mapping = tokenized.get("offset_mapping")
147	
148	        if offset_mapping is None:
149	            raise ValueError(
150	                "Qwen3.5 loss mask generation requires a fast tokenizer " "with `return_offsets_mapping` support."
151	            )
152	
153	        expected_token_ids = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
154	            messages, tokenize=True, tools=tools, return_dict=False
155	        )
156	        if token_ids != expected_token_ids:
157	            raise ValueError(
158	                "Qwen3.5 rendered text tokenization does not match "
159	                "`apply_chat_template(..., tokenize=True)` output."
160	            )
161	
162	        assistant_header = "<|im_start|>assistant\n"
163	        think_prefix = "<think>\n"
164	        end_marker = "<|im_end|>"
165	
166	        char_mask = [0] * len(rendered_text)
167	        cursor = 0
168	
169	        for message in messages:
170	            if message["role"] != "assistant":
171	                continue
172	
173	            header_pos = rendered_text.find(assistant_header, cursor)
174	            if header_pos < 0:
175	                raise ValueError("Failed to locate assistant message in rendered Qwen3.5 chat template output.")
176	
177	            content_start = header_pos + len(assistant_header)
178	            end_pos = rendered_text.find(end_marker, content_start)
179	            if end_pos < 0:
180	                raise ValueError("Failed to locate <|im_end|> for assistant message in rendered text.")
181	
182	            span_end = end_pos + len(end_marker)
183	            if span_end < len(rendered_text) and rendered_text[span_end] == "\n":
184	                span_end += 1
185	            cursor = span_end
186	
187	            if message.get("step_loss_mask", 1) != 1:
188	                continue
189	
190	            if rendered_text[content_start : content_start + len(think_prefix)] == think_prefix:
191	                mask_start = content_start + len(think_prefix)
192	            else:
193	                mask_start = content_start
194	
195	            for pos in range(mask_start, span_end):
196	                char_mask[pos] = 1
197	
198	        char_mask_prefix_sum = [0]
199	        for value in char_mask:
200	            char_mask_prefix_sum.append(char_mask_prefix_sum[-1] + value)
201	
202	        loss_mask = []
203	        for start, end in offset_mapping:
204	            if end <= start:
205	                loss_mask.append(0)
206	            else:
207	                loss_mask.append(1 if char_mask_prefix_sum[end] - char_mask_prefix_sum[start] > 0 else 0)
208	
209	        return token_ids, loss_mask

211	    def gen_multi_turn_loss_mask_distill_qwen(
212	        self, messages: list[dict], tools: list[dict] = None
213	    ) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
214	        prompt = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
215	            messages[:1], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, tools=tools
216	        )
217	        response = messages[-1]["content"]
218	        prompt_tokens = self.tokenizer(prompt, add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"]
219	        response_tokens = self.tokenizer(response, add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"]
220	
221	        response_length = len(response_tokens)
222	        token_ids = prompt_tokens + response_tokens
223	        loss_mask = [0] * len(prompt_tokens) + [1] * response_length
224	
225	        if messages[-1].get("step_loss_mask", 1) != 1:
226	            loss_mask = [0] * len(token_ids)
227	        return token_ids, loss_mask

229	    def get_loss_mask(self, messages: list[dict], tools: list[dict] = None) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
230	        if self.tokenizer_type == "qwen":
231	            if "<｜Assistant｜>" in self.tokenizer.get_added_vocab():
232	                return self.gen_multi_turn_loss_mask_distill_qwen(messages, tools)
233	
234	            return self.gen_multi_turn_loss_mask_qwen(messages, tools)
235	        elif self.tokenizer_type == "qwen3":
236	            return self.gen_multi_turn_loss_mask_qwen3(messages, tools)
237	        elif self.tokenizer_type == "qwen3_5":
238	            return self.gen_multi_turn_loss_mask_qwen3_5(messages, tools)
239	        elif self.tokenizer_type == "distill_qwen":
240	            return self.gen_multi_turn_loss_mask_distill_qwen(messages, tools)
241	        else:
242	            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported tokenizer type: {self.tokenizer_type}")

244	    def get_loss_mask_with_multimodal_alignment(
245	        self, messages: list[dict], input_ids: list[int], tools: list[dict] = None
246	    ) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
247	        text = []
248	        for msg in messages:
249	            if isinstance(msg.get("content"), list):
250	                text_parts = []
251	                for item in msg["content"]:
252	                    if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "text":
253	                        text_parts.append(item.get("text", ""))
254	                    elif isinstance(item, str):
255	                        text_parts.append(item)
256	                text.append({"role": msg["role"], "content": " ".join(text_parts)})
257	            else:
258	                text.append(msg)
259	
260	        _, loss_mask_text = self.get_loss_mask(text, tools=tools)
261	
262	        diff = len(input_ids) - len(loss_mask_text)
263	        assert diff >= 0, (
264	            f"input_ids (length={len(input_ids)}) is shorter than text loss_mask (length={len(loss_mask_text)}) "
265	            f"Please check if processor and tokenizer tokenization are consistent."
266	        )
267	        loss_mask = [0] * diff + loss_mask_text
268	
269	        return input_ids, loss_mask
